description: This file defines a LogWrapper class that implements the LogNode interface, wrapping Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with the ability to chain multiple LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility and implements the LogNode interface, providing a pipeline for logging messages.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message to the Android log and forwards it to the next node if available.
